value: Plaza, M.G., Martinez, S. and Rubiera, F. (2020). CO2 Capture, Use, and Storage in the Cement Industry: State of the Art and Expectations. Energies, 13(21), 5692. doi:10.3390/en13215692 (published 30 October 2020).

Locators are the journal page numbers printed in the header ('N of 28'; Table 1 on pp.20-21). A REVIEW: almost every number is reprinted from CEMCAP papers (Gardarsdottir 2019 cost, Voldsund 2019 technical; both already registered as gardarsdottir_2019_001 and voldsund_2019_001, which probably hold the CEMCAP rows already; treat Plaza as cross-check), Knudsen 2015, Hagg 2017, Nelson 2017, de Lena 2019; each note ends 'reprinted from'. The PDF is a proof copy ('v2') whose text layer has duplicated, overlaid lines (old 'x of 31' layout under the final 'of 28' layout): read with pdftotext -layout and check numbers against Table 1. SPECCA (primary energy per t CO2 avoided) is in other-values, not SEC. Costs are EUR per t CO2 avoided unless 'captured' is in the unit; no price year is stated anywhere (2020 used and flagged). Table 1 SRD figures are reboiler duty (heat), not total energy. Svante's USD 150M for 2 Mt CO2/y and the USD 28M CO2MENT pilot cost are in other-values only.
